primary_outcome: official endpoint RMSE cycles; lower better
secondary_outcome: official endpoint NASA asymmetric sum; lower better
aggregation: per subset, all101/202/303 seeds mean, sample SD, Student-t95%CI; validation and TEST separate
comparison: paired differences within identical subset/seed; report all baseline-minus-reference RMSE/NASA differences, mean+SD+t95CI and better-seed count
reference_selection: fixed names; never choose reference from TEST; no ensemble
multiple_subsets: do not count FD001/FD003 or shared seeds as independent datasets/replicates
inference_limits: n3 seed CI conditional on fixed data; descriptive small-sample comparison, no unconditional superiority claim or pooled p-value
two_phase: separate paired-extra-data/pretraining table, same endpoint evaluation; not equal-resource claim
budget_limits: fixed author window and optimizer settings, zero window tuning, common40 supervisoryepochs/12patience; not exhaustive optimum/equal steps/equal compute
